content_sections.heading: RITES Individual Consultant Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit for all posts is not exceeding 63 years as on the last date of submission of application (8 November 2026).

content_sections.heading: RITES Individual Consultant Salary
content_sections.text: Goods and Service Tax, as applicable, shall be admissible to the Individual Consultant. No statutory benefits like PF, ESI, or Gratuity are applicable.

content_sections.heading: RITES Individual Consultant Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of document scrutiny/verification followed by a personal interview. Candidates will be evaluated based on technical skills, subject knowledge, experience, communication, and interpersonal skills. Shortlisting for the interview is based on meeting the eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RITES Individual Consultant
content_sections.text: Go to the Career Section of the official RITES website at www.rites.com. Fill out the online application form with all required personal, educational, and experience details. Submit the online application and note down the generated Registration Number. Upload scanned copies of all required documents clearly and visibly. Print a copy of the submitted online application form for document verification and interview stages.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: 1 Passport size Photograph High School certificate for proof of Date of Birth Certificates of Academic & Professional qualifications and statements of marks for all semesters/years Copies of experience certificates from previous employers Proof of Identity & Address (Passport, Voter ID, Driving License, Aadhaar Card, etc.) PAN Card Proof of different periods of experience as claimed in the application form Last company relieving letter/experience certificate, NOC for Govt./PSU employees Duly filled Annexure-A checklist

content_sections.heading: RITES Individual Consultant Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The instant engagement is for deployment at a client's site, and offer letters are subject to client approval of CVs and continued project requirements. No TA/DA shall be admissible for joining the assignment or attending the interview. Candidates working in any organization shall be allowed to join only after being properly relieved from their parent organization. Police verification of the Individual Consultant will be conducted as per MHA instructions. The appointment is temporary and can be cancelled at any time by RITES Limited without assigning any reason. Consultants appointed on a full-time basis are not permitted to take up any other assignment during the consultancy period. Applications once submitted cannot be altered. Candidates must ensure that all information provided matches their supporting documents.
